messages:
olivia: Heads-up — planning a compact cross-stack cutover in ~2h. Sequence: API (v4.3.1) -> Runtime (v2.8.0-q) -> Router (header-swap) -> Console. 60m change window, short canary then ramp. Need owner ack and rollback gates.
mike: acked for runtime, I can monitor kv cache and p90.
kevin: Router team: can do header-swap at +10m after runtime green. Suggest 5% canary first, 50% after 15m if metrics stable.
sara: Console + schemas good. We need to pin console client to api v4.3.1 for the window. Posting pin snippet.
olivia: thanks — posting the preflight checklist and rollback criteria below. Keep comms in this thread.
olivia: ```pins:
  api: "4.3.1"
  runtime: "2.8.0-q"
  router: "edge-2026-03-21"
  console: "2026-03-21-pin"
rollbacks:
  - traffic drop > 15% success rate baseline
  - latency p95 increase > 2x baseline for 5m
  - error spike >= 3x baseline for 3m```
kevin: Router note: header-swap requires session-affinity flag off for canary. We'll toggle AFFINITY=false during canary.
mike: runtime note: quantized kernel fallback enabled, but if kv-miss spikes we'll revert to previous runtime build. I'll watch mem hitrate and kv eviction.
sara: console note: we have a short feature-flag to disable new route if something breaks, console will not crash on missing headers.
deploy-bot: preflight checks passed: infra ok, capacity reserve OK, canary buckets available. Trigger with `/deploy cross-cutover v0` when ready.
olivia: timeline: T-30m final go/no-go. T=0 start API canary (5% traffic). T+10m runtime canary rollout. T+20m router header-swap 5% -> 50% at T+35m if stable. Hold T+50m for post-checks, then full rollout.
kevin: adding manual rollback trigger: I will cut header-swap within 90s if errors spike.
mike: also if token cache eviction > 8% sustained for 3m, we roll runtime back.
sara: console will hold read-only mode if downstream errors exceed threshold.
olivia: can everyone react with :thumbsup: if they can be on-call for the window? If no reaction assume on-call.
mike: :thumbsup:
kevin: :thumbsup:
sara: :thumbsup:
olivia: ok queued to run at T-30 for final checks. Will call final go/no-go here.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy cross-cutover by olivia at 6812347777. Canary buckets reserved: canary-a(5%), canary-b(50%).
admin-bot: note: change window 60m recorded in calendar and incident channel for escalation.
olivia: final note — keep console rollouts pinned to api v4.3.1 until T+60m. If any of us loses connectivity ping oncall@pagerduty.
kevin: copying rollback steps into runbook and will have a small script to flip router header flag.
mike: I'll keep logs streaming to the runtime-triage channel. If I see anomalies I'll post immediate rollback request here.
olivia: thanks all. I'll post go/no-go at 6812347688 (T-30).
